MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 46
   C. 120
   D. 30

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

3. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

6. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 7

7. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

8. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 15
   D. 17

10. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 9
   D. 13

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 38
   C. 22
   D. 19

16. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 1

17. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

18. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 49
   C. 8
   D. 7

19. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

20. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 2

21. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

22. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

23. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 14

24. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
